chapter: Road shows, carnivals and New York
title: Leaving Chicago on the road with Charles Taylor's show and carnivals
summary: When Chicago slowed, Punch went on the road three years with Taylor's show, then did carnival tours each summer.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: No, I mean after you were in Chicago. Huh? After you were in Chicago. Well. Things started getting slow, you said.

That's what I said, and this fellow come through with them Brown Manigan I told you about, Charlie Taylor. Mm-hmm. Well, he hadn't heard of me a long time, so he come up to a place where, well he used to work with Miramac, and then had Miramac Miramacos when he first started out. So he had his own show, and he come up and asked, what was I doing? I told him nothing, so he asked me how would I like to make a trip with him. Mm-hmm. So I got with them and went on the road with them, and I must have stayed with them for three years, see. Mm-hmm. Three years. And to tell the truth about it, I have never exactly lived in Chicago no more since then, because when I quit them I went to New York, from New York I got on the road again, then I started trying these carnivores shows. Well that killed it right there. The Royal American, the different O'Connells, I can't call the name of them now, but six or seven different ones, every summer you know. Dress up in the winter, go somewhere in some town in the wintertime and play around, and then go back on the road with them again.
Well that's the thing most that killed me up. Well now, who did you work with in New York?
